node.title: Re: How to tie a lexical filehandle. (updated x2)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
use IO::Handle; my $fh = IO::Handle->new; tie *$fh, ...;

Update: Or the following slightly more low-level way, the relevant code of [https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/blob/4c95ee9f29:/dist/IO/lib/IO/Handle.pm#l313|IO::Handle->new] doesn't do a whole lot more than this:

use Symbol qw/gensym/; my $fh = gensym; tie *$fh, ...;

Links: [doc://IO::Handle], [doc://Symbol].

Update 2017-09-30: One more, from [id://1198343|here]:

my $fh = \do { local *HANDLE };
